ValidationRule.description: This validation rule will require the field called Merchant Status Reason to be populated if the Status MCA field contains a value of Not Interested, Not Qualified or Marketing Scrub.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: ISCHANGED( Status_MCA__c ) && ISPICKVAL( Merchant_Status_Reason__c , "") && (ISPICKVAL(Status_MCA__c, "Not Interested") || ISPICKVAL(Status_MCA__c, "Not Qualified") || ISPICKVAL(Status_MCA__c, "Marketing Scrub"))
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Please select a value from the Merchant Status Reason field. Thank you.
